changes_made.explanation: Removed models that are not NLG models (LASER, Vecalign, Hunalign are alignment/embedding tools, not generation models). Removed duplicate/redundant dataset entries. Removed Chinese language as it's not mentioned in the experiments. Added WMT16 dataset with proper name. Kept only NMT systems as the actual generation models being evaluated.
No changes needed - BLEU is correctly identified as the automatic metric used to evaluate machine translation quality.
Paper does not use LLMs as judges for evaluation - correct as extracted. No LLM-based evaluation methods are mentioned.
Paper does not conduct human evaluations - correct as extracted. Only automatic evaluation with BLEU is mentioned.

overall_notes: This paper focuses on document alignment for machine translation data preparation, not on NLG evaluation methodology. The NLG aspect comes from evaluating downstream MT systems trained on the aligned data. The extraction was mostly accurate but included some non-NLG models (alignment tools) that needed filtering. The paper is primarily about document alignment, with MT evaluation as an application of the method.
